factCheck.setBy: general-purpose fact-check agent, two rounds, live fetches incl. Playwright for ukg.com, 2026-11-09

coldRead.icp: DON at a 25-bed rural hospital, reading once on a phone

undefinedTerms: Workforce Central / WFC (abbreviation used before and after being spelled out; I only half-know it as old Kronos)
on-premises installation (vs cloud) and how to tell which one I am on
end of engineering vs end of life vs support (three different dates, never contrasted in plain words)
UKG Pro Workforce Management / UKG Dimensions (two names, one product; I did not know which one I own)
UKG partners / implementation partner (RSM US, Healthcare IT Leaders, HRchitect: who are they and why trust them)
DOL Fact Sheet #54 (what it will tell me)
termination (of the agreement) vs the day I switch vs the day notice is sent
mondayActions: Ask IT or the UKG account team which UKG product we are on and whether it is on-premises or cloud
Ask whoever holds the contract (administrator or finance) for the term end, renewal, notice period and data-return clauses
Write one page listing what UKG does for us today: scheduling, time clock, payroll feed, HR records
Ask for the nurse roster export and check every per-diem nurse and every unit is in it
Put a calendar reminder for the 30-day data-copy request
blockedActions: I do not hold the UKG contract and cannot pull it; the post never says who usually does
How to actually export the roster and 'recent schedule reports' out of UKG: no steps, and I probably lack the access
Decide whether to move to UKG Pro or leave: no cost for either path, and that call is the administrator's, not mine
Know which date applies to us: three dates given (support March 2027, engineering and Private Cloud December 2025) and no way to tell which matches our installation
Know whether my installation is already past a cutoff if we are on cloud hosting
Run the 60-day plan: it counts back from a 'switch' date I do not have, and the notice period in the contract may be longer than 60 days
See how scheduled hours reach payroll if the new tool 'does not connect to UKG'
Compare cost: SimpleScheduleAI shows 'flat monthly pricing' with no number
